analysis.purpose: CliVcsAdapter.changedFilesSince is an adapter method that delegates to a standalone `changedFilesSince` utility. It provides the VCS contract (listing files changed since a reference) for the CLI's VCS adapter, keeping the adapter thin and routing the work to the real implementation.
responsibilities: Expose a VCS method to list files changed since a given git reference
Delegate to the underlying changedFilesSince implementation

inputs.name: since
inputs.description: Git reference (commit, branch, tag) to compare against

outputs.name: changedFiles
outputs.description: Relative paths of files changed since the reference

sideEffects: May invoke git commands via the delegated utility (not visible in this body)
errorBehavior: Does not handle errors here; any failure from the delegated utility propagates
invariants: Return value is exactly what the delegated changedFilesSince utility returns
preconditions: The delegated `changedFilesSince` function must be importable and callable
The repository at `root` must be a valid git workspace if the utility depends on git
postconditions: Returns an array of changed file paths relative to root
risks: Thin delegation means risks depend entirely on the unresolved callee's implementation
No input validation is performed before delegation
whatToDistrust: The delegated `changedFilesSince` call is unresolved; its exact behavior, side effects, and error conditions are not in the seed

nodes.name: VCS changed-files query
nodes.summary: List repository files changed since a git reference

edges.rationale: The adapter method exposes the changed-files capability by delegating to the concrete utility
